mapper.update: UPDATE document SET title = #{title}, type = #{type}, author = #{author}, content = #{content}, file_size = #{fileSize}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM document WHERE is_deleted = 1 AND user_id = #{userId} AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY deleted_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
